SARANONI ADULT BLANKETS

Saranoni Adult Blankets & Robes

Grown-up softness for the spaces you actually relax in.

Saranoni's adult collection turns the brand's signature softness into everyday indulgence: plush Bamboni robes, weighty faux fur throws, ribbed waffle-knit layers and buttery minky-lush finishes. Built for the sofa, the bed and the quiet moments in between, each piece is substantial enough to feel like a real upgrade and polished enough to leave out instead of tucking away.

SARANONI KIDS BLANKETS

Saranoni Kids Blankets

Everyday comfort with characters they already love.

From double-layer Bamboni blankets to minky-lush throws featuring Batman, Harry Potter and Justice League, Saranoni's kids collection pairs the brand's plush, durable fabrics with prints kids actually ask for. Sized for growing bodies and built for real playroom and bedtime use, without giving up the soft, substantial feel Saranoni is known for.

SARANONI BABY BLANKETS

Saranoni Baby Blankets & Nursery

Gentle softness for the newest member of the family.

Saranoni's baby collection brings the brand's signature softness to the nursery: breathable cotton muslin, plush Lush-finish receiving blankets, swaddle sets and crib sheets designed for sensitive skin. Whether it's a keepsake print or an everyday muslin swaddle, each piece is soft enough for daily use and special enough to hold onto.
